page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at top; floral woodcut ornament with the library stamp to its left, below the title block; imprint block at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (floral, flanking scrolls) between the title block and the imprint; not text. "Martij" is partly covered by an ink stain, so the final letter is doubtful. Ink stains around the title block. The library stamp, the handwritten shelf mark and date at top left, and the handwritten numerals at the top right, bottom centre and bottom right are excluded as not printed. Faint show-through from the reverse is excluded.
